content:
Welcome back to this week's Apple Certified Refurbished Store new arrivals update. This week's featured products include the MacBook Neo, the newly configured MacBook Air, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, with discounts of up to 15%, and you purchase directly from Apple's official website.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Come with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for additional purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, so you don't have to check yourself. Inventory changes rapidly, and we hope this article can help you stay on top of the latest stock so you can grab your desired product before it sells out.

Mac computers

When it comes to price, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top recommendations. Whether you're joining the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to an Apple Silicon model, both are excellent choices.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (original price $799)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (original price $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (original price $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (original price $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (original price $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (original price $1,699)

Studio Display

We reported exclusively a few weeks ago that the Studio Display XDR was available at the Apple Refurbished Store at the time. As we often remind everyone, inventory changes quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (original price $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (original price $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The entry-level Apple TV 4K, which has been in short supply, is back in stock this week, and the higher-end version with an Ethernet port is also available at the same time. The entry-level version typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (original price $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (original price $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want to join the user base as well, the Apple Refurbished Store has several attractive deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular) 49mm Black Titanium Case with Black Ocean Band: $679 (original price $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular) 49mm Natural Titanium Case with Blue Anchor Ocean Band: $679 (original price $799)

As always, if you want to see all of this week's latest Apple deals, please visit 9to5Toys.
